dependency_evidence: European Chiastocheta, including C. rotundiventris, exclusively and obligatorily reproduce in T. europaeus fruits; the directional claim used here is only that the fly requires the plant, not that the plant requires this single fly species.
witness_selection_rule: Freeze exactly twelve Table-1 sites with C. rotundiventris sample count R>0: AMB, BAY, BID, BON, CCO, CDV, CHA, CHE, CRA, CTP, DON, EPO. Use printed coordinates directly; do not add later sites, geocode locality names, or use snapshot information.
host_range_authority: Kew Plants of the World Online 2026: Trollius europaeus accepted; native range Europe to W. Siberia.
known_boundary: Selected prospectively under v7.3 after the pair-admission and snapshot-taxonomy-identity contracts were frozen. No GBIF snapshot taxonomy tuple, occurrence row, count, map, density, cell statistic, or live occurrence search was consulted for selection.
